snowflake-ify.title: NorthStar on Snowflake: where the data moves, and who can touch it
snowflake-ify.alt: Architecture diagram of NorthStar on Snowflake. Inside one Snowflake account, a shared foundation band loads 163K raw rows, cleans them with a SQL task, builds features for 10K customers and registers them in the Feature Store. The retention band trains a churn model in a Python notebook, registers it, scores every customer weekly and feeds a retention campaign. The service band runs a Cortex Agent that searches policy docs, looks up orders and calls return, credit and escalation procedures, logging a trace for every tool call. Purple role chips show which roles can touch each band, and a resource monitor caps warehouse spend.
